name: ironhack.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But the start page tells search engines not to index it.
lesson: Review every noindex on purpose, and remove it from pages you want found.
summary: www.ironhack.com scores 47 out of 100 (F). 11 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: the start page tells search engines not to index it.

fix.title: The start page tells search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Cookiebot was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw TikTok Pixel (8 requests), Hotjar (1 request), Meta Pixel (2 requests), X Ads (2 requests), and cookies _ttp on tiktok.com, _hjSessionUser_673557, guest_id_marketing on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 53 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /de, /de-en, /es and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 8 elements on /de, /de-en, for example #tabs-\:R15a5ddcj5stddda\:--tabpanel-0 > .css-0 > .css-ce8hs0 > .css-1avsa87 and #tabs-\:R15a5ddcj5stddda\:--tabpanel-0 > .css-0 > .css-ce8hs0 > .css-dxwbhr. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Select element must have an accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /de, /de-en, for example #field-\:Rd9lj5stda\: and #field-\:Rl9lj5stda\:. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Deny" and reloading, TikTok Pixel (8 requests), X Ads (3 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 311 ms
Every page has a meta description
